_doc: Render massing for the Sint-Janstoren (Veemarkt, Robbrecht en Daem), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor' (centre of GRB footprint 363006), u along 'axis_deg' (the footprint's long edge). DHMV II: tower 39-46 m over u -20..1, a lower wing at ~12 m over u 2..11. Look from Commons photos (k-in-kortrijk/refs, CC0 / CC BY-SA): a white stepped residential tower with balconies, a dark grey stone plinth of about three storeys under the whole footprint, a roof garden on top. The tower rect is inset 0.3 m so its white walls do not z-fight with the plinth.

parts.id: dark grey plinth and low wing (GRB footprint)
